_doc: Pass 2 of scripts/store-bundle-check.mjs: a UI string in the STORE build that has a STORE_BANNED_WORDS word is allowed only if it contains `match` (case-sensitive) or matches the regex `pattern` in a chunk named `chunk` (file name without Vite's hash; '*' = any). Every entry needs a reason. A reason states a checked fact: the gate that keeps the text from a store user, a false positive, or a reviewed decision. No entry is left open for a later wording decision (round A7, 16 Nov 2026).
